one_line: Real CSVs committed (verified sizes): data/merchant_list_raw_data/BNPL_Merchant_List.csv 1.8 MB and BNPL_Merchant_Categories.csv 3.4 MB (8,470 merchants across Affirm/Klarna/Afterpay/Zip/Sezzle directories), data/public_company_panel_data/public_company_panel_data_2015-2026.csv 3.1 MB (4,675 firm-quarter SEC rows), plus crosswalk, variable definitions and a 14.8 MB source audit; scraper bnpl_scraper.py 36 KB; last commit 2026-08-10; NO licence file.
abnb_use: Gap 3 (RNPL / reserve-now-pay-later) and gap 6 (consumer-credit strength): the merchant directories say which travel and lodging brands carry Affirm/Klarna/Afterpay and — via Internet-Archive CDX adoption dating — roughly when the option appeared, which is the closest public read on whether pay-later financing is spreading through travel booking. The SEC firm-quarter panel is a template for the adoption-window event study rather than an ABNB input.
